thread:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — prepping HelioHealth QBR next week. During onboarding they burned way above expected tokens yesterday, flagged by billing-bot. Need a short triage: safety-net credit provisioning, short-term forecast, and any enablement actions we can show in the QBR.

jules_cs: saw that. Appears heavy embedding + long-context chat sessions. Customer hit concurrent batch that retried a few times.

omar_fin: @jules_cs can you paste the 24h burn numbers? finance wants a pre-QBR runway estimate and a proposed credit buffer. :eyes:

jules_cs: short numbers: total tokens ~ 4.2M (24h), baseline expected ~ 600k. Spike source = embed-heavy endpoint + retry storm.

lina_engineer: the SDK default retry is aggressive for 5xxs. We pushed a recommended patch to their client last month but looks like it wasn't adopted. We can propose an immediate client-side fix (reduce retries, add jitter) + temporary batching to cut per-token rate.

raj_support: customer reported a hiccup around 02:14 UTC, logs: ```
2026-03-20T02:14:08Z ERROR request failed code=500 id=hid_9843 retry=1
2026-03-20T02:14:09Z RETRY request id=hid_9843 retry=2
2026-03-20T02:14:10Z RETRY request id=hid_9843 retry=3
```

billing-bot: alert: account=heliohealth threshold=3x baseline triggered at 4132107400 — estimated overage $1.4k/day if sustained.

emma_cs: OK action items draft: 1) propose one-time safety-net credit (cover ~48h of excess) 2) recommend client patch + enable batching on server side 3) add a short-term budget alert and lower-rate fallback model for spikes 4) capture customer feedback during QBR and get commitment on SDK update.

omar_fin: for the one-time credit, propose $1500 capped. If they accept, finance needs the ask + rationale in one message we can sign off on.

jules_cs: I'll draft the ask. Quick Q: do we have a suggested alert query I can paste?

lina_engineer: paste this alert rule — it's what we used for Vega last month:
```
alert: token_spike_high
expr: sum(rate(redwood_tokens_total{account="heliohealth"}[1h])) > (baseline_tokens_per_hour * 3)
for: 15m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "HelioHealth token burn > 3x baseline"
```
Change baseline_tokens_per_hour to their 7-day rolling avg.

jules_cs: perfect. I'll include that and the support log snippet.

raj_support: also note UI-side: enable a quota banner in console for them so they see the spike in real-time. Small UX win for QBR demo.

emma_cs: timeline: can we have the draft credit ask + alert rule + exec summary by EOD today? QBR dry-run is Tue.

omar_fin: I can review the credit ask by 17:00 PT. If numbers look ok we'll pre-approve for expedited grant.

jules_cs: copying draft below for review — feedback welcome.

--- draft ask ---
Account: HelioHealth (acct_9843)
Issue: Unexpected onboarding spike caused ~4.2M tokens in 24h vs baseline 600k. Cause: embed-heavy flows + client retries during a transient 500-series outage.
Request: One-time safety-net credit $1,500 to cover ~48h of excess burn while we implement mitigations.
Mitigations & asks from customer: adopt SDK retry patch (ETA 48h), enable server-side batching & fallbacks (we can roll in 24h), display quota banner in console.
Business rationale: avoid churn from surprise billing during onboarding, demonstrate quick ops response in QBR.
--- end draft ---

lina_engineer: looks good. Suggest we add expected post-mitigation burn estimate (projected to ~350k/day).

jules_cs: added the projection and pushed update.

emma_cs: thanks everyone. I'll collate and send to @omar_fin for sign-off, then coordinate the customer enablement call. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: note: creating temporary alert channel #cs-heliohealth-spend for 72h.

jules_cs: :raised_hands: thanks — will update thread after finance sign-off and when customer accepts SDK patch.
